messages:
maria: FYI blade kv-6123 OOM after ~36h steady residency growth. not a spike.
aj: shard id + quick heap snippet?
maria: shard=kv-6123. live +340MB in 36h. top objects: session_blob ~100KB, cached_q ~24KB. frag_ratio 19%->38%.
zara: stack samples point to reconnect path skipping TTL, repeated writes to user:session:*.
devin: class this as 'slow-residency'. propose short/med/long split.
maria: short: ingress TTL enforcement + 1.5MB soft reject canary. i'll open hotfix PR. ETA 4h.
aj: i'll add alert: kv_shard_fragment_ratio>30% for 15m -> page, and a dashboard tile for value-size histograms.
qa: i'll build a small harness to simulate low-qps repeated writes to a prefix. docker runner + nightly job. ETA 3d for first cut.
zara: i'll run heap diffs and flamegraphs, label top keys with owners. ETA 24h.
devin: medium-term: RFC for eviction heuristics + slab compaction probe (trigger when frag>35% for 10m). ETA 10d.
aj: also add per-key delta metric (bytes_added_per_key/hr) to catch slow growth earlier.
sre-bot: Incident INC-4512 created for kv-6123 OOM.
maria: acceptance gates: no recurrence for 14 days and harness shows <200MB growth in 48h for 7 nights.
aj: UX: rejections include x-kv-reject-reason and x-kv-correlation-id.
qa: will include local emulator `make run-emulator` so contributors can test.
zara: schedule checkpoint in 48h to review hotfix + harness status.
devin: add recurring 'residency triage' to correlate harness failures with real incidents. rotate owners weekly.
maria: summary of owners: maria=hotfix (due today), aj=alerts/dashboard (due 24h), zara=profiling (24h), qa=harness (3d), devin=RFC (10d). closing for now.
